**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379),

I am much obliged for the cheque, I feel as if I hardly deserved it after all the trouble I have given [Mr Freeman](../persons.html#523).[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The year is hard to read and the letter has been filed under 1875.

[^2]: CMY\'s [History of France](../books.html#99) had been heavily revised after criticism from E. A.

Freeman, the editor of the \'Historical Course for Schools\' series.
